filter: index.csv status == reached and collided False and nav_timed_out False
stratify: noisy x ambiguous, both from the set's scenarios.json (Scenario.noisy, Scenario.ambiguous)
split_rule: per stratum (clean unambiguous, clean ambiguous, noisy unambiguous, noisy ambiguous in this order), n_val = round(val_frac * n) episodes drawn without replacement with one numpy default_rng(split_seed) (train_policy.make_split's rule)
offset_rule: one offset in [0, stride) per training episode (ascending episode order), numpy default_rng(data_seed).integers(0, stride); training rows = steps offset::stride
